name: Whispering Woods
source:
A heartwarming visual novel that follows the journey of three adventurous kids - Sarah, Alex, and Ben - as they embark on an unforgettable adventure.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240412005730/https://kick14.itch.io/whispering-woods]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部温馨的视觉小说，讲述了三个爱冒险的孩子——莎拉、亚历克斯和本——踏上难忘的冒险之旅。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240412005730/https://kick14.itch.io/whispering-woods]Itch.io[/url]]
